title: A few years ago
subtitle: 「幾年前」，究竟是哪一種幾年前？
description: 「幾年前」，究竟是哪一種幾年前？

words.example: Several years ago, the company opened its first overseas office.
words.exampleZh: 幾年前，這家公司開設了第一間海外辦事處。

words.example: Some years ago, she worked as a teacher in a small village.
words.exampleZh: 幾年前，她曾在一條小村莊任教。

words.example: A number of years ago, the museum began digitising its archive.
words.exampleZh: 數年前，這間博物館開始把館藏數碼化。

words.example: Some years back, we used to visit this café every weekend.
words.exampleZh: 幾年前，我們以前每個週末都會來這間咖啡店。

words.example: A few years back, he decided to change careers completely.
words.exampleZh: 幾年前，他決定徹底轉行。

words.example: A while ago, the organisation changed the way it stored customer records.
words.exampleZh: 一段時間以前，這個機構改變了儲存客戶紀錄的方式。

words.example: A little while back, she mentioned that she wanted to move abroad.
words.exampleZh: 早一陣子，她提過想搬到外國。

words.example: Years ago, this building was used as a railway station.
words.exampleZh: 多年前，這座建築物曾是一個火車站。

words.example: A couple of years ago, they moved into a larger office.
words.exampleZh: 大約兩年前，他們搬進了一間較大的辦公室。

words.example: A handful of years ago, the area looked very different.
words.exampleZh: 幾年前，這個地區的面貌還很不一樣。

words.meaning: 不久以前；沒有很多年前
words.example: Not many years ago, most payments in the town were still made in cash.
words.exampleZh: 沒有很多年前，這個城鎮大部分付款仍然使用現金。

words.example: I moved there a few years ago. Back then, the neighbourhood was much quieter.
words.exampleZh: 我幾年前搬到那裡。當時，那個社區安靜得多。

words.example: The policy was introduced a few years ago. At the time, few people expected it to last.
words.exampleZh: 這項政策幾年前推出。當時，很少人預料它會維持下去。

words.example: She joined the firm in 2018; several years earlier, she had worked in Singapore.
words.exampleZh: 她在2018年加入公司；再早幾年，她曾在新加坡工作。

falseSynonyms.zh: earlier 通常要有另一個過去時間作基準；ago 通常以現在為基準。
只表示較早，可能只是幾分鐘、幾天或幾年；沒有 year-scale 距離。
通常表示較近的過去，不等於明確的幾年前。
表示很久以前，通常比 a few years ago 更遙遠。
通常指不久前的某一天，時間尺度遠短於數年。
只表示曾經，沒有告訴讀者距今多久。
需要參照點或上下文；單獨不等於 a few years ago。
表示持續時間，不是某事件發生於幾年前。
